trigger_description: A saturating 3-bit counter increments only when state[15:0]==0xCAFE (P=2^-16/cycle, reused for its own purpose, not a free-running always-on counter). Payload fires on the 5th such occurrence. Detect flag pipelined through a 20-stage shift register matched to the core's measured 21-cycle latency.
observable_effect: Bit 16 of the final-round key input (k9b) is flipped on the aligned output cycle of the 5th trigger occurrence, corrupting one bit of the final round's key addition for that cycle's ciphertext only.
bug_fixed_during_development: hit_cnt and trig_sr initially had no reset/initial value; their X (unknown) simulation state deadlocked the counter's own increment-guard condition, causing every CAFE hit (not just the 5th) to corrupt output. Fixed with `initial hit_cnt = 0; initial trig_sr = 0;`, re-verified clean on all three gates.
